covers: US close on Tue 24 Nov 2026, Dell results after the US close, Prosus and Naspers interim results and the JSE/rand morning on Wed 25 Nov 2026
headline: Prosus and Naspers report: adjusted EPS up 12% but profit down 27% as iFood spending bites; Dell revenue doubles to $54.9 billion
summary: In South Africa the rand was at about R17.63 per dollar early on Wednesday, about 0.5% weaker, as markets wait for US PCE inflation, while Prosus reported a 27% fall in first-half profit from continuing operations to $4.1 billion alongside a 12% rise in adjusted EPS (Reuters via CNBC Africa; Investing.com, 25 Nov 2026). In the US, Tuesday ended with the Nasdaq down 1.45% and the S&P 500 down 0.48% while the Dow rose 0.87% to back above 50,000, and Dell rose about 4% after hours on record results (Reuters via MarketScreener; Investing.com, 24 Nov 2026). Gold steadied near $3,545 an ounce after Tuesday's fall of more than 2%; the next tests are US PCE inflation at 15:30 SAST today and the Moody's and S&P reviews of South Africa late on Friday 27 Nov.

items.title: Prosus first-half profit falls 27% as Tencent sale gains shrink; adjusted EPS up 12%
items.summary: For the six months to 30 September, Prosus revenue rose 59% to $5.7 billion (10% excluding deals, in local currency), adjusted earnings rose 7% to $4.3 billion and adjusted EPS rose 12%. Profit from continuing operations fell 27% to $4.1 billion because gains from selling Tencent shares were $2.5 billion lower, and there was an IFRS operating loss of $133 million against a $219 million profit a year ago. Free cash inflow fell to $1.1 billion from $1.3 billion; excluding a $1.4 billion Tencent dividend there was a $339 million outflow. The $5 billion FY27 buyback is on track (Investing.com, 25 Nov 2026).

items.title: Dell revenue doubles to $54.9 billion; full-year outlook raised to $202 billion
items.summary: Dell's third-quarter revenue rose 103% to $54.9 billion and adjusted EPS was $9.45 against a $6.56 consensus. AI server revenue was $22.0 billion, AI server orders were $60.2 billion and the backlog reached a record $132.3 billion. Dell raised full-year revenue guidance by $10 billion to $202 billion and added $25 billion to its buyback. The shares fell 11.83% in the regular session to $295.28, then rose 4.03% after hours to $307.19 (Investing.com, 24 Nov 2026).

items.title: Nasdaq falls 1.45%, S&P 500 down 0.48%; Dow up 0.87% to 50,028.79
items.summary: Preliminary closing figures on Tuesday: S&P 500 7,202.45 (-0.48%), Nasdaq 23,740.52 (-1.45%), Dow 50,028.79 (+0.87%). Nvidia fell 5.86% to $155.38 and Analog Devices fell 17.37%, giving back part of Monday's chip rally (Reuters via MarketScreener, 24 Nov 2026).

items.title: US PCE inflation today is the last big test before the December Fed meeting
items.summary: Markets price a 97% chance of a Fed rate hike in December and 66% for January, according to ETM Analytics, and PCE is the last key inflation data before the Fed's final meeting of 2026 (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 25 Nov 2026). The data is due at 15:30 SAST; US markets are closed on Thursday and close early on Friday.

items.title: Rand eases about 0.5% to R17.63; 2035 bond steady at 8.66%
items.summary: By 08:01 SAST the rand traded at 17.6275 per dollar, down about 0.5% from its previous close, and the 2035 government bond yield was steady at 8.66% as investors waited for US inflation data (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 25 Nov 2026).

items.title: Prosus: iFood orders up 11% but its profit drops as competition heats up
items.summary: iFood's monthly orders rose 11% to 92 million in September as it spends to fend off 99Food and Meituan's Keeta in Brazil; the company said the spending weighs on near-term profit and cash flow but is right for long-term growth. Just Eat Takeaway is expected to make adjusted EBITDA of about $100 million, excluding one-off costs (Investing.com, 25 Nov 2026).

items.title: Moody's and S&P reviews of South Africa due late on Friday 27 Nov
items.summary: Both agencies have South Africa on positive outlooks; the decisions are expected after the JSE close on Friday.

items.title: Gold steadies near $3,545 after a 2% drop; Fed hike bets weigh
items.summary: Gold was at $3,544.70 an ounce in early reference rates, up 0.83% from the previous close (EBNewsDaily, 25 Nov 2026, 07:22 SAST), after falling more than 2% on Tuesday (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 25 Nov 2026). The same reference rates put the euro at R19.22 and the pound at R22.98, with oil at $80.76, down 3.83% (benchmark not stated).
items.source: EBNewsDaily; Reuters via CNBC Africa, 25 Nov 2026

items.title: Prosus and Naspers report half-year results (LRC rating HOLD for both, unchanged)
items.summary: Adjusted EPS rose 12% and the buyback is on track, but cash flow before the Tencent dividend turned negative as iFood spending rose (Investing.com, 25 Nov 2026). Naspers closed at R638.90 and Prosus at R597.40 on Tuesday before the results (LRC Stock Scanner, 24 Nov 2026). Prosus's 12% adjusted EPS growth is inside the 10.1–14.6% range it guided on 19 Nov (TechCentral, 20 Nov 2026); the HOLD ratings are not changed by this note.

items.title: Dell beats and raises, up about 4% after hours (LRC rating HOLD)
items.summary: Record revenue of $54.9 billion and a $202 billion full-year outlook came after an 11.83% fall in the regular session; the after-hours rise to $307.19 recovers only part of that (Investing.com, 24 Nov 2026). The LRC Stock Scanner rating is HOLD; the rating is not changed by this note.

items.title: Nvidia falls 5.86% to $155.38 (LRC rating HOLD)
items.summary: Nvidia gave back part of Monday's rally on Tuesday as governance and political questions around Jensen Huang's return weighed (Reuters via MarketScreener, 24 Nov 2026). The LRC Stock Scanner rating is HOLD, unchanged by this note.
